name: Upeh Reception Broker
role: Fictional reception contact for Javanese and Luzon-facing traders
bio: A captain who cannot find a warehouse door asks this broker for an introduction. The broker can request help from Utimutiraja’s people without promising their consent.
notes: fact: Pires lists a shahbandar for Javanese and Luzon-facing merchants but does not name the sultanate incumbent (Pires II, p. 265; people-factions.md §4)
gameplay: This contact and the Upeh household tie are inventions. The contact is not Kadir, Colascar or Regimo under an earlier title (people-factions.md §4)
